subject: Packaging orchestration and concession request — clarifying tier pairing
messages:
From: Aiden Park <aiden@novapulse.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@novapulse.com
Date: Sun, 05 Oct 2025 22:14:00 +0000
Subject: Packaging question + ask for concession

Hi Jasmine / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — product looked great. We dug into traffic patterns this morning and have two follow-ups on packaging before we line up procurement:

1) We currently run a mix of burst traffic and steady nightly batch jobs. Your standard "Throughput Plus" tier seems to match steady load, but a lot of our burst will be short spikes. Can we pair the Throughput tier with the Compact feature bundle (KV caching + quantization) for a hybrid price?

2) Procurement wants to understand concession mechanics if we commit 12 months upfront. Are there standard discount bands for Reserved Dedicated vs Hosted API usage? If so, how do add-ons (multi-region failover, extended logs retention) affect tier pricing?

I've attached a short requirements doc that shows our sequence length distributions and burst windows. Would appreciate a recommended configuration and an outline of the trade-offs.

Also, we may need a slight SLA note in contract (99.5% monthly P99 target) — would that push this into a Dedicated-only solution?

Best,
Aiden

[Attachment: novapulse_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Aiden Park <aiden@novapulse.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging question + ask for concession

Hi Aiden — thanks for the details and the attachment.

Short answer: yes, we can compose a hybrid that pairs a Throughput seat commitment with the Compact feature bundle, but there are a few knobs we should align on so we price it correctly. I'm including the recommended approach below and attaching a pricing sheet for the proposed configuration.

Summary recommendation (high level):
- Baseline: 2x Throughput reserved seats (handles steady nightly batch).
- Burst capacity: dynamic burst on Hosted API with a capped monthly spend to limit exposure (we can set a hard burst ceiling).
- Feature bundle: Compact (KV caching + selective quantization + prefix caching) enabled for both reserved and hosted routes to reduce per-token cost by ~20–30% for your workload shape.
- SLA: 99.5% monthly P99 can be met on Dedicated; for Hosted we offer best-effort plus runbook SLA (we can negotiate a blended SLA if Dedicated baseline is accepted).

Concession / discount mechanics:
- 12-month commitment discount: typically 18–25% off list for the combined reserved throughput seats (range depends on final committed TUs).
- Burst usage on Hosted is billed at standard hosted rates; we will apply a blended effective rate when average monthly usage exceeds the committed baseline.
- Add-ons (multi-region, longer retention) are additive — we can cap their monthly incremental cost or include a modest discount if purchased as part of the 12-month bundle.

Open questions for pricing accuracy:
- Confirm expected monthly token average vs peak burst month.
- Which regions require failover (US only or US+EU)?
- Is the retention add-on mandatory at purchase or optional later?

Next steps: I attached a tailored pricing sheet (redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx). If this looks good, Ben and I can draft a short mutual action plan and we can route a 12-month MSA with the requested SLA clauses for your legal team to review.

Thanks — I included Ben (pricing) and Lauren (CS) for impact on onboarding and runbook.

—
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
+1 415‑555‑0123

[Attachment: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: internal: price math + concession options for NP-3819

Jasmine — a couple of notes for the proposal to Aiden / NovaPulse: 

1) For the 12‑month reserved commitment we can offer 22% off the reserved-throughput list if they commit to a minimum monthly TU (we should call it 18k TUs/mo to be conservative). If they agree to a 24k TU floor, push to 25% and offer an onboarding credit of $8,000.

2) Burst cap: suggest we propose a soft cap of $6k/mo on hosted bursts with automatic throttle alerts and a one‑time override for critical windows. If they want a hard cap we need legal approval (falls into billing protection clause).

3) Compact bundle discount: 10% when purchased as a bundle with reserved seats (we justify by standardization of quantization profiles + prefix cache tuning).

4) SLA note: we can put the 99.5% P99 target in the MSA for Dedicated baseline but include an SLA waterfall tying hosted fallback to degraded remediation steps — avoids outright refusal from legal.

I'll prepare two price options (Conservative floor / Aggressive floor) and send back by EOD for you to share. Also looping Priyom for any quants that should be considered on the 20–40 token sequence bucket.

—Ben

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Aiden Park <aiden@novapulse.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, contracts@novapulse.com
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 16:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Packaging orchestration and concession request — clarifying tier pairing

Hi Aiden — thanks for the patience. Attached is a short MPP (mutual product plan) and two pricing options: Conservative (18k TU floor, 22% off reserved) and Growth (24k TU floor, 25% off + $8k onboarding credit).

Quick notes:
- We recommend US-only multi-region failover for phase 1 to keep costs predictable; we can add EU failover in month 7 if needed.
- Compact bundle is included in both options and reduces effective per-token cost by ~22% on your sample traces.
- Hosted burst will be metered at list but we apply a blended rate if bursts push monthly usage above committed baseline (sheet details in redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx).

If this looks ok, can contracts at NovaPulse sign the attached MSA redlines so legal can iterate? I'm including a DocuSign link for the MSA and the pricing option selection: https://app.docusign.com/NP-3819/MSA

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm preferred option by EOD Thu (10/9).
2) We route MSA + SLA redline (attached) to your legal.
3) Kickoff onboarding a week after execution; Lauren will coordinate runbooks.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Jasmine
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: MSA_redlines.pdf (pdf)]
